title: Beyond Latent Personalization: Integrating HRV-Conditioned Personalization via LLM for Interpretable Stress Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.23555v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stress detection based on heart rate variability (HRV) has received increasing attention. However, existing personalized approaches integrate personal attributes with HRV through latent representations, limiting the interpretability of their interactions. In this work, we propose an LLM-enhanced personalized stress detection framework that integrates HRV features and personal attributes through LLM-based semantic interpretation. The proposed framework achieves a 29.9% relative MCC improvement over the strongest baseline on TILES-2018 while providing human-readable descriptions of individual physiological responses. The results highlight the potential of LLM-based semantic interpretation for achieving both effective and interpretable personalized stress detection.

translated_title: 超越潜在个性化：通过大语言模型整合基于HRV条件化的个性化以实现可解释的压力检测
translated_abstract: 基于心率变异性（HRV）的压力检测受到越来越多的关注。然而，现有的个性化方法通过潜在表示将个人属性与HRV进行整合，限制了二者交互的可解释性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种由大语言模型（LLM）增强的个性化压力检测框架，该框架通过基于LLM的语义解释来整合HRV特征和个人属性。在TILES-2018数据集上，所提出的框架相比最强基线实现了29.9%的相对MCC提升，同时提供了人类可读的个体生理反应描述。这些结果凸显了基于LLM的语义解释在实现既有效又可解释的个性化压力检测方面的潜力。
tldr: 该论文提出一种通过LLM语义解释整合HRV特征与个人属性的个性化压力检测框架，以人类可读的方式描述个体生理反应，在TILES-2018数据集上相比最强基线实现29.9%的相对MCC提升，兼顾了检测性能与可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-enhanced personalized stress detection framework that integrates HRV features and personal attributes through human-readable semantic interpretation, achieving a 29.9% relative MCC improvement over the strongest baseline on TILES-2018 while ensuring interpretability.
